title: Scrapyd Unauthenticated Egg Upload RCE
description: Scrapyd 1.2.1 listening on port 6800 without authentication: addversion.json accepts a Python egg from anyone, and Scrapyd imports it (to list spiders) and runs it, so code in the egg runs on the server.
question: Upload a malicious egg to the open Scrapyd API to run commands and get a shell.
